nodes.speaker: character-commander
nodes.line: The stone hums awake. A circle of light rolls out over the moor, and the fog lifts off every road it touches.

nodes.speaker: class-cleric
nodes.line: Look up. The Manalith. It eased, just a hair.

nodes.speaker: class-knight
nodes.line: If one stone does that, there are more of them out there. Only you can see them. Lead the way.
